name: ct_virtual_colonoscopy
description: Order a CT virtual colonoscopy (CT colonography) as a minimally invasive alternative to optical colonoscopy for colorectal cancer screening and polyp detection.

region.description: Body region to image (colon spans abdomen and pelvis)

clinical_indication.description: Reason for the exam (e.g., colorectal cancer screening, incomplete colonoscopy)

when_to_use: colorectal cancer screening in average-risk patients who decline optical colonoscopy
incomplete optical colonoscopy requiring evaluation of proximal colon
elderly or comorbid patients where sedation-based colonoscopy is high risk
evaluation of colonic obstruction distal to a mass
surveillance of known polyps not amenable to endoscopic removal

examples.query: 70-year-old patient with multiple comorbidities, needs colorectal cancer screening but poor sedation candidate

args.clinical_indication: colorectal cancer screening, high sedation risk
